summary: Independently verifies Phase 145G.3's repair of F-145G.2V-1 (decision-session identity-bound resumption), without relying on Phase 145G.3's own report or tests as authority. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. Confirmed via git history that the pre-repair gap (no identity channel, no owner comparison, an unconditional readiness idempotent-cache-hit success) reproduces exactly as F-145G.2V-1 described. Confirmed via live adversarial CLI execution against a disposable scratch repository that the current implementation enforces a single, non-duplicated owner-identity comparison (SessionApplicationService._require_bound_identity) ahead of every state-mutating action and every idempotent/cache-hit early-return path across all seven resumption commands (evidence/select/clarify/preview/confirm/readiness/cancel) -- including the specific readiness cache-hit bypass F-145G.2V-1 itself named, which could not be reproduced. Confirmed exactly one identity-claim channel (--as-identity) exists with no implicit/environmental fallback (adversarially tested by injecting $USER/$USERNAME/$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/$PCAE_IDENTITY/$PCAE_AGENT_ID with a mismatched value -- rejection held regardless). Confirmed status's exemption is substantively justified (pure read, no mutation, no new disclosure enabled by impersonation), CLI/application/persistence dependency boundaries are intact (the one CLI-to-persistence import is a pre-existing, policy-documented, test-enforced composition-root exception unrelated to this phase), and fast_green (4391/4391) is unaffected. Three Non-Blocking findings recorded: persisted owner_identity has no cryptographic tamper-evidence (a pre-existing filesystem-trust characteristic of the persistence layer generally, not a regression within this repair's scope); a cosmetic __all__ omission for EXIT_IDENTITY_BINDING_MISMATCH; status incidentally returns owner_identity in its payload, not actionable by a mismatched caller. F-145G.2V-1 is confirmed closed. See docs/PHASE_145G3V_DECISION_SESSION_IDENTITY_BOUND_RESUMPTION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
